implementation: Preflight checks Fast input_audit_sha256 against the exact supplied/model-bound audit.
Actual hubs/IDs SHA256 must match their paired Fast manifest; absolute or manifest-relative raw paths resolve before use.
Frozen bindings of manifest, hubs and IDs are saved in execution metadata; acceptance report carries them too.
Both subprocess commands use the checked resolved raw paths.
Each count/timing/trace cell verifies the frozen manifest and raw hashes before launching and after successful completion.
Acceptance additionally checks the Fast fit fingerprints and original accepted P2 raw paths.
fixed_findings.compatibility: No protocol, model family, order, query count, L/K/m, thread count or measurement schedule changed; acceptance optional --fast-manifest defaults to the existing paired20K path.

validation.cases: valid absolute/relative path binding; wrong input audit; preflight hubs/IDs mismatch; frozen hubs/IDs/manifest mutation; restored original files; both runners

finalizer_review: Prior source and synthetic-selftest findings remain valid at unchanged d1945203 source.
limits: This follows the R1 source/input-binding fix only. It does not grant P1 real-model or P3 performance PASS, and future full10K artifact alignment/gates remain required.
